I might rehearse my lines over and over, but when the moment comes, my voice might sound shaky, and I might mumble or stumble over my words. I might try to avoid eye contact with the audience, hoping they won't notice my nervousness. I might also have a strong urge to run away or disappear, but I know I have to stand my ground and face my fears. Despite all this, I try to remind myself that everyone gets nervous, and it's okay to not be perfect. With time and practice, I hope to become more comfortable and confident in speaking in front of groups.
